subject: percentages from annotate.WithGenicPart not matching with number of differentially methyated regions using  regionCounts command

messages.author: cecd2e39601459ac
messages.subject: percentages from annotate.WithGenicPart not matching with number of differentially methyated regions using  regionCounts command
parts:
Hello,

I am having difficulty determining how methylKit assigns sites to promoter regions.

When i annotate the location of my differentially methylated regions I obtained the following percentages for 1643 differentially metyhlated regions.

percentage of target features overlapping with annotation (with promoter>exon>intron precedence) :
  promoter       exon     intron intergenic
  14.54656   13.81619   35.84906   35.7881

however, when i tried to extract the differentially methylated regions  within the promoter region using the regionCounts command  there are only 214 rows (i.e. 214 differentially methylated regions found within the promoter region), however 14.55 % of 1643 is 239 and i don't understand why im getting different numbers for number of differentially methylated regions within the promoters. The commands i used to extract these numbers are give below.

Is this the correct way to extract the locations of the 14.55% of differentially methylated regions that fall within the promoter or is there another trick?

Thank you in advance for your help,

Claire

annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff20p,gene.obj)
diffAnn <- annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff20p, gene.obj)
diffAnn
promoter=regionCounts(myobj, gene.obj$promoters)
promoter

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] percentages from annotate.WithGenicPart not matching with number of differentially methyated regions using regionCounts command
parts:
Hi,
I'm not sure I understand the problem 100% but the correct way to get differentially methylated regions that overlap with the promoters is to use annotate.WithGenicParts(). regionCounts() is for something else, not for annotation. it might behave differentially depending on what class is "myobj" 

Best,
Altuna
